feature_name: Persist gRPC Address Updates on Reattach
description: Update the storage controller to persist gRPC address changes when reattaching a pageserver. Currently, gRPC addresses are tracked in memory but not saved to the database, causing them to be lost across restarts or service disruptions. This feature ensures that when a pageserver reattaches, its updated gRPC address is written to the database for permanent storage.
functional_requirements: Modify the reattach operation to update the gRPC address field in the database record for the pageserver
Ensure the updated gRPC address persists across storage controller restarts and service interruptions
Maintain backward compatibility with existing database schema and reattach workflows
